stem: Which statement about IgE-mediated food allergy is true regarding its clinical presentation?

options.text: Future reaction severity is highly predictable
A clear history of prior exposure is always present
Resolution of the reaction generally occurs within 24 hours
It always involves the digestive tract immediately
Symptoms always begin several days after exposure

explanation: Resolution of the reaction generally occurs within 24 hours. IgE-mediated food allergy reactions are typically acute and short-lived once the trigger has been removed or treated.

optionExplanations.A: Incorrect because the severity of future reactions is not highly predictable and can vary from one exposure to the next.
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because a clear history of prior exposure is not always present in children with IgE-mediated food allergy.
optionExplanations.C: Correct because IgE-mediated food allergy reactions are usually acute and generally settle within 24 hours.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because IgE-mediated food allergy does not always present with immediate gastrointestinal involvement; skin and respiratory symptoms are also common.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because IgE-mediated reactions are typically rapid in onset, not delayed by several days.

source.hint: Reflect on the typical duration of a single allergic episode once it has started.
